targets.query:
from(bucket: "ur3e")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "robotarm.pt.state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "robot_mode")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: string(v: r._value) }))

from(bucket: "ur3e")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "robotarm.ctrl")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "type")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: string(v: r._value) }))

from(bucket: "ur3e")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "stuck_joint.status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /stuck_joints_.*/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: string(v: r._value) }))

from(bucket: "ur3e")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "rt_model.dt.state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /joint_max_acceleration_.*/ or r["_field"] =~ /joint_max_speed_.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "ur3e")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "rt_model.dt.state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /q_actual_.*/ or r["_field"] =~ /q_target_.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "ur3e")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "robotarm.pt.state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /tcp_pose_.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
